_comment: Configuration descriptors of the simulated keyboard, one array per descriptor (shared by mockusb.js and m32dfu_trace.py). app: MIDI + DFU runtime on interface 2 (attrs 0x09, detach 255 ms, 64-byte transfers) as in firmware/usb/usb_device.c. dfu: NI bootloader, DFU-mode protocol 2, attrs 0x0B, 1024-byte transfers.
